question: In a certain code language, ‘MISTAKE’ is coded as ‘9765412’, and ‘NAKED’ is coded as ‘84123’. How will ‘INTIMATE’ be coded in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d7fd46426f00ba56b91d423458faa673503496b14e50413ec14eae6a6e84c211.png] 

The logic followed here is :-

‘MISTAKE’ is coded as ‘9765412’.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/57d429607f0d9b728d9267603a9ec376a57136e6013f29800909d48cec220f3f.png] 

And

‘NAKED’ is coded as ‘84123’.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/57abb075e3a9bd23264054a4961d4279f44ea4281ed9c44681b5387c7726c6cd.png] 

Similarly,

‘INTIMATE’ will be coded as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e2b51720f9ff56ff1f32b250e4e93476c0d786756b38c842b69556bf51a1604f.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"78579452".**
